subject: ancient-history
topicName: The Fall of the Roman Republic

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Gracchi brothers (Tiberius d.133 BC, Gaius d.121 BC) tried to reform land distribution; both were killed by senatorial opposition

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Marius reformed the army: soldiers swore loyalty to their general (not the state), giving ambitious commanders private armies

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Sulla marched his army on Rome (88 BC) — the first time a Roman general used military force against the city itself

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The First Triumvirate (60 BC): Caesar, Pompey and Crassus dominated politics; it was an unofficial power-sharing agreement

steps.body: Gracchi = reform attempts killed by Senate; showed system was broken Marius' reform = soldiers loyal to general, not state (root cause) Sulla = first to march on Rome; Caesar crossed the Rubicon Ides of March = 44 BC; killed Caesar but didn't restore the Republic
